title: Michael Johnson's visit and matching drawings
place_text: Hanes Way Apartments, Rapid City, South Dakota

tellings.quote: everything he saw the craft he saw the black sphere in front of the vehicle jumping up and down he smelled the smell he heard do not fear he heard all that and saw every bit of it
Let's do something here, man. I saw something. I want to write it down before I forget.
tellings.difference: Told by Michael himself, firsthand, rather than by Mario; it stresses that he wanted to write it down before forgetting.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Michael's visit to Mario's home in Rapid City, where Michael drew what he saw. This telling gives Michael's side of the visit that Mario describes.

as_told.title: Michael draws the alien at Mario's home before leaving

plain: In 1977, at the Hanes Way Apartments in Rapid City, South Dakota, two Air Force men found that their memories of a strange encounter matched: a craft, a black sphere bouncing up and down in front of their vehicle, a smell, and a voice saying "do not fear". A former nuclear-weapons guard named Mario Woods says his fellow airman Michael Johnson came to see him and had seen and heard every bit of it, and their drawings of the craft matched. Johnson tells it himself, decades later, stressing that he said "I want to write it down before I forget."
